neighbours.label: the suffix token 'ation' split off a word stem (ovation, staycation, claymation, imitation)
fire: After her final song the crowd rose and gave her a standing ovation.
This summer we skipped the airport and planned a cheap staycation at home.
The studio is famous for its claymation films with wobbly plasticine heroes.
When the pitcher walked off the mound, the ovation lasted almost a minute.
Many families chose a staycation instead of flying abroad this year.
He made a short claymation video for the band's new single.
The museum's copy is a cheap imitation of the original marble statue.
Critics praised the play, and the opening night ended with a long ovation.
quiet: After her final song the crowd rose and gave her loud, warm applause.
This summer we skipped the airport and planned a cheap holiday at home.
The studio is famous for its puppet films with wobbly plasticine heroes.
When the pitcher walked off the mound, the cheering lasted almost a minute.
Many families chose a road trip instead of flying abroad this year.
He made a short cartoon video for the band's new single.
The museum's copy is a cheap replica of the original marble statue.
Critics praised the play, and the opening night ended with long cheers.

notes: tokenizer split matters: fire depends on 'ation' being its own token
